entries.081212553def9665: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,220 million, an increase from the previous fiscal year. Automotive products-related sales exceeded the previous fiscal year despite the impact of production cuts for some adopted vehicle models, while industrial materials-related sales were supported by demand for decorative covers for air-conditioner piping and repair materials for sewers. entries.0fb2fac91edbaa2b: The company's challenges are to secure stable earnings in the industrial materials division by also focusing on public works-related business, which is less affected by consumer spending; to expand share and earnings in the automotive products division by strengthening product development capabilities; and to expand sales by dispersing production sites and using overseas bases as starting points, and it intends to address these under its medium-term company-wide execution plan.
